design.name: rv_uadd8x2_to_u9
design.description: Clocked unsigned 8b+8b adder with ready/valid input and output, single-entry output register, one-cycle no-stall latency, backpressure-stable output, synchronous active-low reset.

operations.name: uadd_pair
operations.semantics: On each accepted input transfer, compute exact unsigned sum S=A+B where A and B are 8-bit unsigned operands and S is 9-bit unsigned with zero-extension carry-out preserved; no truncation, no saturation, no wrap beyond 9 bits.

data_types.name: u9
data_types.overflow_semantics: Exact representable range 0..510; no overflow for 8b+8b.

compute.organization: single scalar adder datapath with registered output
compute.dataflow: transactional stream: accept input then publish sum next cycle
compute.parallelism: one transaction in flight in output register
compute.scheduling: single-cycle compute from accepted input to output register write when output slot empty

storage.name: out_reg
storage.access_pattern: write on accepted input; hold until accepted output
storage.port_requirements: 1 write source (adder result), 1 read sink (output channel), valid bit
storage.reuse_semantics: no reuse; each entry consumed once
storage.lifetime: from input acceptance cycle+1 visibility until output handshake

pipeline.responsibility: input handshake qualification and combinational add
pipeline.stall_behavior: if out_reg valid and out_ready=0, in_ready=0 so no acceptance

pipeline.responsibility: store/hold sum and drive output handshake
pipeline.valid_behavior: out_valid reflects valid flag; out_sum reflects stored sum
pipeline.stall_behavior: while out_valid&& !out_ready, out_sum and out_valid remain stable

control.state_progression: EMPTY -> FULL on input transfer; FULL -> EMPTY on output transfer. Simultaneous dequeue/enqueue in FULL is architecturally forbidden; if FULL at cycle start, in_ready=0 for that cycle regardless of out_ready/in_valid, so next input can be accepted no earlier than the first cycle after FULL->EMPTY.
control.error_behavior: No command channel; protocol violation only if environment changes payload while stalled, DUT behavior unspecified beyond handshake contract; DUT raises no error output.
control.error_recovery: Recovery by external protocol compliance and reset; reset clears valid state deterministically.

reset.required_state: on cycle with rst_n=0: out_valid=0, in_ready=0, output register content don't-care but held deterministic by flops, pending/pre-reset work discarded

architecture_contract.latency_model: Exact, no-stall case: if input transfer occurs at cycle t (ready&&valid sampled high at rising edge, rst_n=1), corresponding output becomes valid at cycle t+1 and must transfer at t+1 when out_ready=1. Backpressure may delay output transfer arbitrarily; value remains stable until transfer. During stall at output, in_ready=0 so no new input accepted.
architectural_invariants: Each accepted input transaction produces exactly one output transaction with value A+B in 9-bit unsigned arithmetic.
No output transaction occurs without a prior accepted input transaction after last reset.
Output payload and valid remain stable during any cycle with out_valid=1 and out_ready=0.
Reset aborts all pending work and deasserts out_valid synchronously.
open_assumptions: Input channel payload packing uses two dedicated 8-bit signals (op_a, op_b) rather than a packed 16-bit bus for simplicity.
No internal queue beyond required single-entry output register; therefore input backpressures whenever output register occupied.
No error/status/completion sideband is exposed because user request did not require it.

interface_contract.protocol: dual ready/valid streaming channels (input and output)

channels.name: in_chan
channels.purpose: ingress of two unsigned 8-bit operands per transaction
channels.framing: one transfer = one operand pair transaction
channels.ordering: acceptance order defines job order; no reordering
channels.backpressure: DUT deasserts in_ready when output register occupied or reset asserted

channels.name: out_chan
channels.purpose: egress of unsigned 9-bit sum per transaction
channels.backpressure: sink controls via out_ready; DUT holds out_valid and payload stable while stalled

signals.name: clk
signals.semantic: Rising-edge clock for all state updates.

signals.name: rst_n
signals.semantic: Synchronous active-low reset; when 0 at rising edge, clears output-valid state and discards pending work; no transfer is accepted on that edge.

signals.name: in_valid
signals.semantic: Input producer indicates op_a/op_b are valid.

signals.name: in_ready
signals.semantic: DUT can accept input pair when 1.

signals.name: out_valid
signals.semantic: DUT asserts when out_sum holds an unconsumed sum.

signals.name: out_ready
signals.semantic: Output consumer ready to accept sum.

signals.name: out_sum
signals.semantic: Unsigned exact sum of one previously accepted input pair.

global_handshake_rules.transfer_condition: A channel transfer occurs on rising clock edge iff channel_valid && channel_ready && rst_n==1. If rst_n==0 on edge, transfer is suppressed/aborted for both channels.
global_handshake_rules.stall_behavior: For any ready/valid channel, producer must hold valid and payload stable while valid=1 and ready=0. On reset edge (rst_n=0), DUT may withdraw out_valid and clear pending output immediately by next cycle per reset rule.

modules.name: rv_uadd8_top
modules.responsibility: Implements full datapath, handshake control, single-entry output register, and synchronous active-low reset behavior.

ports.name: in_ready
ports.semantics: Input ready; high only when output register empty and not in reset cycle.

ports.name: out_sum
ports.semantics: Stored 9-bit unsigned sum; stable during stall.

functional: For every accepted input transfer (in_valid&&in_ready on clk edge with rst_n=1), exactly one output transfer eventually occurs with out_sum == zero_extend(in_op_a)+zero_extend(in_op_b).
No output transfer may occur without a corresponding prior accepted input after most recent reset.
Output ordering equals input acceptance ordering.
verification: Randomized simulation with >=100 accepted transactions spanning full 8-bit operand range and random backpressure on out_ready.
Reset tests required: assert rst_n low during idle, during pending output stall, and coincident with potential handshake edges; verify pending work discarded and out_valid deasserted.
Backpressure tests required: when out_valid=1 and out_ready=0 for multiple cycles, out_sum and out_valid remain stable.
Handshake rule test: transfer only when ready&&valid&&rst_n==1; reset edge suppresses transfer.
One-cycle no-stall latency test: with out_ready held high and no prior occupancy, output valid appears exactly 1 cycle after accepted input.
Boundary arithmetic tests: (0,0)->0, (255,0)->255, (255,255)->510, random mid values exact match integer model.
rtl: RTL must be synthesizable SystemVerilog only; no forbidden constructs (real/shortreal/delay/force-release/classes).
Single top module implementation with single-entry output register and no optional/runtime-config modes.
Deterministic synchronous active-low reset behavior implemented as specified.
fpga_handoff: Vivado synthesis handoff allowed only after verification criteria pass.
Report metrics only from deterministic Vivado tool reports per required schema; no estimated/fabricated PPA numbers.

original_revision_feedback.summary: Contract is close, but has one semantic conflict and one missing executable rule that can cause inconsistent implementations around same-cycle dequeue/enqueue behavior.

findings.issue: States simultaneous dequeue/enqueue in FULL is architecturally forbidden and in_ready=0 for whole cycle when FULL at cycle start, even if out_ready=1. This conflicts with the user requirement of one-cycle latency without stalls (in steady no-backpressure operation, this rule injects bubbles and reduces throughput).
findings.requested_change: Revise control and latency semantics to allow same-edge dequeue/enqueue when FULL and out_ready=1 (or explicitly justify and update user-level requirement if throughput is intentionally limited). Ensure rule is consistent across control, pipeline stall_behavior, interface backpressure text, and latency model.

findings.issue: Reset behavior says output register content is don't-care while also requiring deterministic behavior; no explicit post-reset value rule for out_sum when out_valid=0. This can create ambiguity for verification and RTL style checks.
findings.requested_change: Add an explicit executable rule: either (a) out_sum is unconstrained when out_valid=0, or (b) out_sum is driven to a defined reset value (e.g., 0). Keep this consistent in reset section, signal semantics, and acceptance checks.

requested_architect_decision: Correct the reported local patch/references while preserving unaffected contract fields.
